Apply Philips MR Quantitative Floating-Point or Console Display Scaling

Source: R/modality-transforms.R
dicom_mr_rescale.Rd

Rescales MR pixel intensities following Chenevert et al. (2014) and the Philips DICOM Conformance Statement using public RescaleIntercept (0028,1052) (RI) / RescaleSlope (0028,1053) (RS) and proprietary Philips private tags (2005,100D) (ScaleIntercept, SI) and (2005,100E) (ScaleSlope, SS).

Usage

dicom_mr_rescale(x, philips_float = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A dicom_volume or path to DICOM files.

philips_float

Logical. When TRUE (default) and Philips ScaleSlope (2005,100E) is present, returns quantitative floating-point values \(P = D / (RS \times SS)\); when FALSE, returns console display values D.

Value

A dicom_volume with rescaled voxel values and appended provenance.

Details

For stored integer pixel values R, console display values are \(D = R \times RS + RI\) and quantitative floating-point values are \(P = D / (RS \times SS)\). Automatically accounts for whether x was already RS/RI-rescaled by read_dicom_volume(), preventing double-rescaling.

Examples

out_dir <- tempfile("mr_demo_")
dicom_synthesize(
  out_dir = out_dir,
  modality = "MR",
  dims = c(16L, 16L, 2L),
  extra_tags = list("(2005,100D)" = "5.0", "(2005,100E)" = "2.0")
)
vol <- read_dicom_volume(out_dir)
rescaled <- dicom_mr_rescale(vol, philips_float = TRUE)
rescaled
#> <dicom_volume [MR] 16x16x2 | coord=LPS>
#>   spacing: (1, 1, 2.5) mm | origin: (-16, -16, 0) mm
#>   frame_meta: 2 row(s) | provenance: 2 step(s)
unlink(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
